evidence: read_agreements now allows the requester, the responder, a delegate with the business 'leads' scope (has_business_scope) and admins (production policy, 2026-09-16); the lifecycle RPCs use the same check (e.g. agreement_confirm_payment refuses with NOT_RESPONDER only outside it).
/u/:id is registered in src/App.tsx (PublicProfile), so the party card on an agreement opens a profile instead of a blank route.
cancel_expired_agreements uses a 12-hour confirmation window (production definition, 2026-09-16) and the i18n copy says 12 hours in en/hi/mr (E2E-025).
public.agreements has exactly one policy — read_agreements — and no UPDATE policy at all (production, 2026-09-16), so every state change goes through the checked RPCs.
Same fix as CUSTOMER_RATINGS CRAT-3: RateScreen derives the other party from isRequester and requestService.rate takes an explicit ratee (E2E-027).
AgreementScreen has a 'Chat with <the other party>' action that opens (or creates) the thread through chatService.getOrCreate.
agreement_dispute writes notifications, including to admins (production source check, 2026-09-16).
DealUpiSheet resolves the UPI id per entity (fetchUpiForEntity reads businesses.upi_id / providers.upi_id by entity id), so a deal a team member submitted still pays the shop.
actionAreaHeight is 240 for ACTIVE (160 CANCELLED, 150 REVIEW-as-requester, 88 otherwise) and the scroll container pads by that plus the safe-area inset, so the fixed bar no longer clips the page.

Payment reminders go through request_payment_nudge (20260980): the server enforces a 6-hour cooldown for agreements and refuses an already-paid one, replacing a cooldown that lived only in that device's localStorage.
cancel_expired_agreements reverts only proposals in ACCEPTED or REJECTED, leaving WITHDRAWN ones alone (production definition carries the 'protecting WITHDRAWN proposals (A11)' comment).
grep '#fff' in AgreementScreen.tsx and DealUpiSheet.tsx: none (2026-09-16).
AskCompose refuses to post when no location could be resolved (hasNoLocation) and tells the user to set their area, instead of filing the request at 0,0 where no provider can ever match it.
uploadService.upload compresses images before upload (compressImage), so a full-resolution phone photo no longer exceeds the storage limit.
AskCompose appends the smart-template answers to the description as a 'Details:' block before posting, so responders see them.
Dictation follows the app language: rec.lang = hi-IN / mr-IN / en-IN.
The loose substring category match is gone from AskCompose — dictation fills the text only, and the category stays the user's choice.
The compose screen's app bar shows a Clear action (handleClearDraft) whenever the form or a restored draft has content, and a restored draft announces itself with a 'Draft restored' toast.

Reachable only through 'Me too', which has had no entry point since bb5c22e and whose fate is owner decision E2E-028. If group buying comes back, meToo must pass p_delivery_address for DOORSTEP requests before it ships.
grep '#fff' in AskCompose.tsx: none (2026-09-16) — surfaces use var(--surface), text on coloured fills var(--white).

accept_proposal_counter accepts the responder side and honours business scopes (has_business_scope), so a counter-offer can be accepted by either party (production source check, 2026-09-16). E2E critical/request-proposal-agreement drives requester → counter → acceptance.
withdraw_proposal and proposal_submit_counter both consult has_business_scope, so an owner or scoped team member can withdraw or counter a proposal the business submitted.
SubmitProposal finds an existing SUBMITTED proposal for the current identity, disables sending and says 'You already submitted an active proposal'.
SubmitProposal blocks anything but an OPEN request (r.status !== 'OPEN' guard at line ~98).
proposal_counters is in the supabase_realtime publication alongside requests, proposals and agreements (production, 2026-09-16), so counters arrive live.

requestService.submitProposal throws UNAUTHORIZED_RESPONDER_ENTITY when the entity check fails instead of quietly sending the proposal as the person — the comment at that branch records exactly this (P6).
SubmitProposal loads the provider's saved quote templates (loadQuoteTemplates) and offers them in the form.
RequestDetail asks for confirmation before accepting a proposal (an Accept Proposal sheet), rather than firing the irreversible RPC on the first tap.
Budgets render through formatBudget, which handles a one-sided budget instead of collapsing it to 'Open budget'.
submitProposal reads the entity's blurb and writes responder_tagline (businesses.description / providers.bio, capped at 140 chars) — the column it used to read didn't exist (E2E-035).
SubmitProposal surfaces the server's message (e.message) instead of a blanket 'Couldn't send. Try again.'
grep '#fff' in SubmitProposal.tsx and RequestDetail.tsx: none (2026-09-16), and SubmitProposal's fixed bottom bar pads with env(safe-area-inset-bottom).
